title: POST /api/integration/ha-url (422 url_not_allowed)
description: The URL is neither HA's configured external_url nor a Nabu Casa remote UI address (https://<instance>.ui.nabu.casa, no port, no path), or not an http(s) URL. The integration logs it once and does not offer the same URL again until the value changes. A body that does not match ha-url.request.json is answered with FastAPI's HTTPValidationError instead.
